notes.title: New Localizations Added: French, German, and Italian!
notes.content:
Great news! We've just launched a big update for both seasons of The Last Door with some long-awaited localizations added! 

Changelog: 
- Added new languages: Italian, French, and German. 
- Minor fixes in gameplay. 
- Minor fixes in localization. 

Which means you can now play The Last Door Season 1 in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Catalan, Polish, and Turkish!
